prompt_en: A fashion editorial photograph of an adult woman in her late twenties making a practical lighting adjustment on a temporary photography set inside a glass-roofed transit concourse after rain. Use the attached portrait only as guidance for visible face and hair appearance: a short dark bob with airy bangs, softly rounded facial contours, dark eyes and natural glossy lips. She wears a fully opaque deep-teal long-sleeved one-piece jumpsuit with a closed neckline and full-length trouser legs. The same solid garment closely follows her torso, waist and hip contours, with shaped seams and small tension folds proving a fitted textile surface. Its opaque fabric continues uninterrupted across the chest, abdomen and pelvis. A separate loose tan hip-length coat hangs around that fitted base, its two open front edges falling outward and its broad sleeve folds keeping a visible air gap from the underlying jumpsuit. She stands upright on the level stone floor with her torso almost frontal. Her right hand turns the brass tilt knob on the side yoke of a vintage spotlight at shoulder height beside her; her left arm rests naturally beside her hip. Her attentive face remains readable as she glances toward the lamp. Frame the complete head through the knees at chest height, with both coat edges, the fitted waist and hips, and the operative hand visible together. Repeating roof arches form a quiet symmetrical backdrop above shallow reflections on the damp floor. Late-afternoon daylight shows the teal seam relief and tan drape as distinct materials, with a restrained warm accent on the brass lamp housing. At the front, an opaque garment closely follows the adult torso waist and hip outline; continuous fabric covers those regions without transmitting underlying skin detail; visible hems seams and local folds identify a textile surface separate from skin. Across the two layers, a fitted inner garment and a separate loose outer garment remain individually readable; the outer layer stands away from the body while the inner follows its local contour; visible overlaps hems or lapels establish the two garments' layer order.
